review_text: Hiding in plain sight. I only learned about this branch one evening when I drove past. It's a cute, warm, little cafe that needs no introduction. It looks tidy and weightless inside due to the interior and lighting. A variety of pasta, rice meals, pizza, soups, salads, and beverages comprise the menu. My order tasted good. Will definitely swing by if parking allows it.

Good Food and drinks. A bit slower service because of lack of staff to prepare food and drinks. Perfect place for students to study. Wifi available. Overall the vibe of the cafe and the aesthetic is really nice
